question: Should OpenRouter be enabled now in the existing token-account model as a narrow provider slice, or should it wait for the broader provider-instance design?
rationale: The likely implementation is small, but VISION.md explicitly reserves new feature and provider-authentication or credential-storage behavior for maintainer sign-off, and the documented versus registered support state needs reconciliation.

options.title: Approve existing-model support
options.body: Register OpenRouter in the shared token-account catalog and add focused compatibility and account-isolation coverage without introducing a generic provider-instance abstraction.

options.title: Defer to provider instances
options.body: Keep this issue open but defer implementation until the product direction in https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/issues/1843 is settled.

recommendation.title: Approve existing-model support
recommendation.body: Register OpenRouter in the shared token-account catalog and add focused compatibility and account-isolation coverage without introducing a generic provider-instance abstraction.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete owns the vision and release direction governing provider authentication and stored credentials.
